# freshdesk_group (Data Source)

Look up a single agent group by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_group" "billing" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the group to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the agents in the group.
- `auto_ticket_assign` (Number) Automatic ticket assignment mode.
- `business_hour_id` (Number) ID of the business-hours calendar the group follows.
- `created_at` (String) When the group was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `escalate_to` (Number) ID of the agent emailed about unassigned tickets.
- `name` (String) Name of the group.
- `unassigned_for` (String) How long a ticket may stay unassigned.
- `updated_at` (String) When the group was last changed (RFC 3339).
